decisions.decision: Reject naive two-system DOVER-Lap fusion. Author explicitly warns equal two-way conflict retains both labels, usually degrading results. Save per-mic disagreements instead.

Cue-composable speaker/spatial design is a relevant architecture reference, not a deployable replacement. Current v0.1 is research preview, pretrained packages and inference CLI under validation. No dependencies or weights installed.

Use real conversational Mandarin/English and measure target word errors as well as voice identity and non-target leakage. Keep development/test separation; corrected challenge scoring is not a score guarantee for our pipeline.

Do not substitute the evaluation ResNet encoder into a192D-ECAPA cue checkpoint. Existing complete pinned author inference and strict tensor roundtrip remain authoritative for that failed experiment; no model retry from an ambiguous model-card note.

correctedPublicChallengeContext.importantScope: Combined MandarinCER/EnglishWER averaged per target mix-enrollment sample with officialZipformer ASR. Not our fixed-mapping30s edit count, not ordinary full-meetingCER, not a guarantee or a reason to change our<5% acceptance target. Raw public challenge clips and current final holdout not downloaded.
correctedPublicChallengeContext.direction: Measure retained target words, speaker identity, non-target leakage and actual overlap separately; do not equate a good-sounding separator or low ordinary speech CER with solved overlap.

facts: Uses BSRNN with both framewise and pooled speaker cues, matching model architecture/weights.
Focuses on processed real far-field conversational training and multi-stage curriculum, not just choosing a larger separator.
Uses explicitly absent-target examples during training, and acknowledges large synthetic-to-real domain gap.
Warns that optimizing speaker-similarity/MOS metrics can produce artifacts or optimistic scores without better perceived identity.
winningSystemMethodReview.ourInferenceNotClaimOfReproduction: The next joint front end should retain consistent speaker evidence and real-domain word preservation/non-target rejection. Do not repeat top1-cosine presence gating, a small fixed-feature head, MOS optimization or a sweep of synthetic2speaker models. True reference-guided causal control below will decide whether diarization alone is a plausible next focus.
winningSystemMethodReview.thisTurnActions: Primary report read and limitations recorded; no new training, encoder substitution, model install or final-holdout access.
